description: Fetch metadata for one or more WHO GHO indicator codes: the full indicator name and the dimensions it supports (e.g. COUNTRY, REGION, SEX, YEAR, WORLDBANKINCOMEGROUP, AGEGROUP). Call this before querying data with who_query_indicator_data to confirm which filter dimensions are valid for a given indicator. Accepts up to 10 codes per call. Many valid indicators have no dimension listing upstream — those return an empty dimensions array with a dimensionsNote, not a not-found. Only codes absent from the catalog are reported in the notFound array, and that is reported rather than raised as an error.

indicator_codes.description: One to ten indicator codes, e.g. ["WHOSIS_000001", "MDG_0000000026"].

name: who_get_indicator_metadata

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `all_not_found`: No requested indicator code resolved to a catalog entry. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

indicators.description: Metadata for each code that resolved to a catalog entry.

dimensions.description: Dimensions this indicator supports for filtering in who_query_indicator_data. Empty when the GHO dimension table lists none for this code — see dimensionsNote.

items.description: A dimension entry supported by this indicator.

dimensionsNote.description: Present only when dimensions is empty: explains that the listing is missing upstream rather than the indicator being absent, and how to recover the dimensions from a sample data row.

indicatorName.description: Full indicator name as returned by the GHO catalog.

notFound.description: Indicator codes that resolved to neither a catalog name nor any dimension rows — they do not exist in the GHO catalog.

title: Get WHO GHO Indicator Metadata
